title: Almost Controlled: The FDR of Benjamini-Hochberg on Weighted Conformal p-Values
abstract: arXiv:2611.21509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weighted conformal p-values generalize conformal inference to cases with covariate shift. One way to use them is to pass them to the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure, either to decide which test units to select or to detect outliers. But weighted conformal p-values may not be positively dependent, so we want to know: does BH still control the false discovery rate (FDR) in finite samples? Based on experiments, it appears to, but we prove it doesn't. We give two counterexamples, certified in exact rational arithmetic, where the FDR exceeds its target level $q$. We also identify how large the difference between the FDR and $q$ can be. With $n$ calibration points, $m$ test units and weight ratio $B$, the relative excess $\mathrm{FDR}/q-1$ is bounded by a function of $n$, $m$, $B$ and $q$ that is of order $\sqrt{Bm/(nq)}$ when $Bm/(nq)$ is small. The bound holds for every configuration with $B\le n$ and every $n$. This order can be reached

translated_title: 近乎受控：Benjamini-Hochberg方法在加权保形p值上的错误发现率
translated_abstract: 加权保形p值将保形推断推广到了存在协变量偏移的情形。使用它们的一种方式是将其输入Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序，用于决定选择哪些测试单元或检测异常值。但加权保形p值可能不满足正相关性，因此我们想知道：在有限样本中，BH程序是否仍然能控制错误发现率（FDR）？基于实验，它似乎可以，但我们证明了它并不能。我们给出了两个反例，并通过精确的有理数算术加以认证，其中FDR超过了其目标水平q。我们还确定了FDR与q之间的差异可以有多大。当有n个校准点、m个测试单元和权重比B时，相对超额FDR/q-1被一个关于n、m、B和q的函数所界定，当Bm/(nq)较小时，该函数的阶为√(Bm/(nq))。该界对B≤n的每一种配置以及每一个n都成立。这一阶是可以达到的
tldr: 本文通过经精确算术认证的反例证明Benjamini-Hochberg程序在有限样本中无法总是控制加权保形p值的错误发现率，并量化了FDR相对超出目标水平的上界（阶约为√(Bm/(nq))）。
en_tdlr: This paper proves, via exactly certified counterexamples, that the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure fails to control the FDR of weighted conformal p-values in finite samples, while bounding the relative excess by a term of order √(Bm/(nq)).
